Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with ongoing right knee pain, swelling, and reduced range of
motion. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported knee complaint, and no prior injury to this body area is known to
the treating office. Over the course of fourteen visits, treatment consisted of physical therapy, anti-inflammatory medication,
activity modification, and periodic reassessment. The recovery timeline ran somewhat longer than is typical for this type of knee
injury, which we attribute to persistent effusion and guarding during the early phase of care. Examination findings were mixed:
joint line tenderness and a positive effusion sign support the injury, while ligament stability testing and neurovascular checks
were within normal limits. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. At last follow-up the
patient was improving with a home exercise program and is expected to return to usual activities with continued conservative
management.
